notes.title: Spooky Express will release on October 21st! 🎃
notes.notes: [p][i]All aboard the Spooky Express![/i][/p][p]Our newest game will be be pulling into the station on [b]October 21st, 2025 [/b]🎃[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613242/ae096275ed36a1d1ae8b7fd51d4e66ba6d0c68c1.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]Take charge of the Spooky Express; the only rail service willing to carry the undead passengers of deepest, darkest Trainsylvania. In your new role, you'll plan routes and lay train tracks to meet your creepy commuters' demands, and create a rail network spanning more than 150 thoughtfully designed levels.[/i] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613242/9d0f41e19ed4f6bbd1da06c4d4506b98cd89a6c1.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Additionally we're excited to announce that Spooky Express will also be available on mobile devices. [url="https://apps.apple.com/app/id6738424828"]Pre-order Spooky Express on iOS[/url], now, or [url="https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=express.spooky"]pre-register on Android[/url][b] to be notified[/b] once it's available.[/p][p]To celebrate the launch date, we've added a [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3352310/Spooky_Express/"]new and improved demo[/url] you can play right here on Steam. If you've already played the demo, the puzzles will be the same but we've added quality of life improvements, and an intro comic introducing the narrative. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613242/704a6d38529c21a325c097d37ac2356bb5f4ce62.png"][/img][/p][p]if you want to help share the news, you can do so on [url="https://bsky.app/profile/draknek.bsky.social"]BlueSky[/url], [url="https://mastodon.gamedev.place/@draknek"]Mastodon[/url] and check out the announcement trailer.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="mV1eSyI8XA8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3352310/Spooky_Express/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
